analysis: Report packet latency, actual accepted prefix/replacement lengths, exact-rule and coupling overhead, and cost per resolved move relative to one full step. Use maximum host times and total resolved counts. Separate H4/H8 and expert/alternating drafts; no completed-game or MCTS-equivalence claim. Prefill and future cache repair excluded, so failure rejects this configuration while success only permits a continuous rollout study.
qualification: Exact Rust boards and legal masks for every active draft step; target block probabilities within TV .04 of full-history BF16 reference; all ranks must pass. Both expert and alternating expert/behavior drafts target the full expert policy for both actual players.
scope: One HLO contains shallow autoregressive decoding, exact capture/suicide/positional-superko transitions using lossless packed history, visual tokens, and deep block verification. No host callback or learned board dynamics.
